metadata.name: GRACE 2.0 ACS Risk Score (1-Year Mortality)
metadata.summary: Non-linear restricted cubic spline Cox model (UMass GRACE Risk Score V2) estimating 1-year all-cause mortality in patients presenting with acute coronary syndrome.
clinical_pearls: Replaces linear GRACE 1.0 point bins with restricted cubic splines for age, heart rate, SBP, and serum creatinine (Fox et al., BMJ Open 2014; UMass GRACE V2 2017).
1-year mortality risk strata: <3% Low, 3.0–7.9% Intermediate, >=8.0% High.
Widely validated across > 20,000 ACS patients (AUC ~0.8) to guide invasive strategy timing and risk communication.
Pitfall — Prognostic only & STEMI timing: Not designed to diagnose undifferentiated chest pain or ACS, and must never delay emergent reperfusion in STEMI.

Pitfall — Calibration drift & unmeasured factors: Calibration can vary over time or across health systems; omits frailty, comorbidity burden, and socioeconomic factors, and relies on subjective Killip class.

options.label: Class I — No heart failure signs
Class II — Rales / S3 gallop / JVD

interpretation.label: Low 1-Year Mortality Risk (<3.0%)
interpretation.summary: Low 1-year mortality risk after ACS; consider selective/guideline-paced invasive strategy.

interpretation.label: Intermediate 1-Year Mortality Risk (3.0–7.9%)
interpretation.summary: Intermediate 1-year mortality risk; early invasive evaluation generally appropriate.

interpretation.label: High 1-Year Mortality Risk (>=8.0%)
interpretation.summary: High 1-year mortality risk; prioritize early invasive strategy (<24h in NSTE-ACS) and intensive secondary prevention.
